# Roberto Moraes — Portfolio

> Multilingual professional portfolio of Roberto Moraes, a software engineer and IT manager focused on high-performance backend systems, cloud architecture, technical leadership, and digital products.

This site is available in Portuguese, English, and Spanish. Portuguese is the canonical default language. Prefer the localized URLs below when presenting or summarizing its content.

## Portfolio

- [Português](https://robertomoraes.dev/): Professional experience, selected projects, technical stack, metrics, insights, and contact information in Portuguese.
- [English](https://robertomoraes.dev/en): English version of the complete portfolio.
- [Español](https://robertomoraes.dev/es): Spanish version of the complete portfolio.

## Technical insights

- [Go em produção](https://robertomoraes.dev/insights/go-em-producao): Portuguese article about operating a Go API under real production load, covering architecture, performance, cache, observability, security, incidents, and deployment practices.
- [Go in production](https://robertomoraes.dev/en/insights/go-em-producao): English version of the production engineering article.
- [Go en producción](https://robertomoraes.dev/es/insights/go-em-producao): Spanish version of the production engineering article.
